title: Power Apps: form fill assistance adds lookup, rich text and multi-select choice fields
summary: Hold: the app toolbar control path starts inside the app designer without explaining how to reach it from Power Apps. The roadmap facts and cited licensing requirements are supported, but the statement that rich text fields hold longer content also needs narrowing.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to expand Power Apps model-driven app form fill assistance to lookup, rich text and multi-select choice fields.
claims.quote: We’re expanding form fill assistance in model-driven applications in Power Apps to support lookup, rich text, and multi-select choice fields, helping users complete more of their forms with AI-powered suggestions and less manual entry.

claims.claim: A preview Copilot control can allow specified users or exclude specified users within an environment, and includes form fill assistance.

claims.claim: Navigating away with unsaved suggestions prompts the user about discarding them.
claims.quote: If you have unsaved suggestions in a form and try to navigate away, you get a prompt asking if you want to discard those suggestions.

claims.claim: A user can accept all suggestions on the open tab with one action.
claims.quote: To accept all suggestions on the open tab of the form, select Accept all suggestions on the notification bar.
